Hi Laura and Marcus,

I wanted to let you both know that I am resigning from my role as Senior Account Executive, with my last day planned for Monday, Nov 17 (two weeks). This was a difficult decision for personal reasons. I will do my best to wrap up active deals and hand off ongoing items.

A few specific asks so we can make this transition clean:
- Confirm PTO payout and timing for final paycheck.
- Let me know the process for equipment return.
- I would like to discuss an optional separation agreement if Redwood is open to a short severance for a smooth transition.

I attached a short resignation note for records. Happy to jump on a brief call today or tomorrow to walk through the immediate plan.

Thanks for the support —
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Neha — thank you for letting us know and for the offer to support during the next two weeks.

I attached the standard exit checklist; that will cover equipment, access, and payroll timing. Immediate next steps:
1) Marcus, please coordinate a 60–90 minute knowledge-transfer session schedule with Neha (recommended: split across two days).
2) Neha, please fill out the equipment list on page 2 of the checklist and confirm any outstanding customer commitments by EOD tomorrow.
3) Stephanie (HR ops), I’m looping you to coordinate PTO payout and to confirm whether we need to offer any severance in this case — Neha asked about it.

If Neha is open to a short call, I can do 30 minutes today at 3:00pm PT to cover logistics.
